why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 has to FAIL because it can only be checked after merge, and the output must point at pages.yml or the publish-on-push. In the output, line 3 is marked "result": "FAIL". Its evidence opens with "This can only be checked after merge. .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ to GitHub Pages only on push to main, so at PR time the live page still shows the old docs/index.md." That names both the file and the trigger. The wrong_build section says the same thing, and the output also suggests a line that can be checked at PR time (docs/index.md documents --shout). So the only must_catch item is fully handled.
